hypotheses.G1_fixed_distance_lexical_directions_rec: Same-token-pair state deltas have median cosine at least 0.20 on both corpora after fixing position and distance.
hypotheses.G2_fixed_distance_semantic_abstraction: Same-family different-word state deltas exceed different-family controls by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G3_fixed_distance_input_reconfiguration_: Same-family input-projector changes exceed different-family controls by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G4_fixed_distance_behavior_reconfigurati: Same-family Fisher-projector changes exceed different-family controls by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G5_fixed_distance_deltas_hit_top_axes: At least 5% of edit energy lies in the four leading input-sensitivity axes on both corpora.
hypotheses.G6_fixed_distance_final_mlp_mediates: Final-position Layer-8 MLP-input patch fidelity is at least 0.25 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G7_position_control_rescues_lexical_recu: Fixing edit position increases same-pair state-delta cosine by at least 0.05 over the variable-distance baseline on both corpora.
hypotheses.G8_high_effect_semantic_state_abstractio: Among the two largest-KL contexts per lexical pair, same-family state-delta cosine exceeds different-family controls by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G9_high_effect_input_reconfiguration_rec: Among high-effect contexts, same-family input-projector change exceeds different-family controls by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G10_high_effect_behavior_reconfiguration: Among high-effect contexts, same-family Fisher-projector change exceeds different-family controls by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G11_high_effect_deltas_hit_top_axes: Among high-effect contexts, at least 5% of semantic delta energy lies in the four leading local axes on both corpora.
hypotheses.G12_high_effect_final_mlp_mediates: Among high-effect contexts, final Layer-8 MLP-input patch fidelity is at least 0.25 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G13_fixed_distance_input_operator_is_edi: Base and counterfactual rank-4 input-sensitivity subspaces overlap by at least 0.90 on both corpora.
hypotheses.G14_fixed_distance_behavioral_operator_i: Base and counterfactual rank-4 Fisher-output subspaces overlap by at least 0.75 on both corpora.
